title: Apple just killed the App Store as we know it

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Apple just let developers sell paid apps outside the App Store — and it’s a game-changer.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This could mean lower prices, more choices, and bigger profits for creators.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They’re allowing direct purchases through a new feature called “App Clips.”

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: App Clips let users buy and use apps without ever downloading them.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers can now skip the 30% commission Apple charges on in-app purchases.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The real power here is that users get more control over how they spend.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: So, are you ready for an App Store that’s not the only game in town?

caption_text: Apple just killed the App Store as we know it
